title: Bali and Singapore | From Tropical Paradise to Urban Oasis
highlights: Journey through Bali’s breathtaking landscapes and Singapore’s futuristic attractions, combining nature, culture, and urban adventures in one seamless trip.
Explore Tegallalang Rice Terraces, admire panoramic views of Mt. Batur from Kintamani Highlands, and soar above the rice fields on the Bali Swing.
Enjoy water activities like banana boat rides, parasailing, jet skiing, and more at Tanjung Benoa Beach, famous for its pristine white sand and turquoise water.
Stroll through the streets of Chinatown, visit the iconic Merlion statue, and walk across the Helix Bridge, resembling a DNA strand, on a Singapore sightseeing tour.
Take a scenic cable car ride to Sentosa Island and spend your day splashing through high-speed slides, at the Adventure Cove Waterpark.

know_before_you_go: Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience.
Kindly carry a valid photo ID proof. PAN Card will not be considered valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as proof of identity.
Visa assistance will be provided however charges are not included.
Personal Expenses and mandatory hotel taxes (if any) will be paid by the travellers at the destination.
International / Domestic flights are not included in the Singapore Bali Package.
Please note that it is mandatory to purchase travel insurance while visiting Singapore. Travel insurance is not a part of Singapore Bali Package.
Images are for representation purposes only.
Please note that Singapore has a strict policy against littering in public areas. Heavy fines are in place for those found littering.
Kindly do not carry any chewing gum as it is banned in Singapore and defaulters will be penalised.
Please note that jaywalking is not allowed in Singapore, if caught, fines will be imposed.
Eating and drinking on public transport is not allowed.
Singapore’s climate is commonly tropical and humid. It is advisable to carry light, comfortable clothes.
Smoking is not allowed until and unless you are in a designated smoking area.
While credit card payments are widely accepted in Singapore, it is recommended that you carry some cash for small purchases.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Kuta | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at the Bali International Airport, you’ll get transferred to the hotel in Kuta. Post check in, rest for a while and spend the day at leisure. You can visit Upside Down World, an indoor activity fit for all ages. Here, you’ll find everyday objects placed upside down. Later, watch the beautiful sunset from Kuta Beach or attend cultural performances such as Kecak dance shows in Kuta Theatre. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kintamani Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board your pre-booked transfer for an assisted sightseeing tour of Central Bali, starting with the Tegenungan Waterfall. Enjoy the scenic Tegallalang Rice Terraces and continue to the Kintamani Highlands, taking in panoramic views of Mount Batur. Don’t miss the chance to sample the famous Luwak coffee (at your own cost) and try the thrilling Bali Swing over the rice fields. After a full day of adventure, get driven to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach | Pirate Dinner Cruise
days.desc: Today, get driven for a day full of adventure at Tanjung Benoa Beach. You can try thrilling activities like banana boat rides, jet skiing along Bali’s picturesque coastline, or soaring high above the shorelines while parasailing. Later, savour a sunset dinner with a pirate theme aboard a traditional Phinisi vessel, where live music and dance performances set the mood for an enchanting evening. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Singapore | Leisure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to the Bali International Airport(tickets not included) for your onward journey to Singapore. Upon arrival at Singapore Changi Airport, check in at the hotel and spend the day at leisure. You can explore the ArtScience Museum and the Asian Civilisations Museum to delve into Singapore's history. Next, explore the world’s biggest display of orchids at the National Orchid Garden, home to more than 60,000 specimens. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Singapore Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven for a Singapore sightseeing tour. Visit the iconic Helix Bridge, an architectural marvel that offers stunning views of the city’s skyline. Continue to the Merlion Statue, a mythical creature with the head of a lion and the body of a fish. Next, admire the Singapore Flyer or explore Suntec City, a premier shopping destination. Later, visit attractions like the Civilian War Memorial and the Esplanade Theatre before getting transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Sentosa Island | Adventure Cove Waterpark | Wings of Time Show
days.desc: Board your transfer for a day trip to Sentosa Island. Enjoy a cable car ride from Mount Faber to reach the island. Spend your day at Adventure Cove Waterpark, where you can snorkel around the Rainbow Reef, and be amazed by vibrant colours of over 20,000 reef inhabitants. Try the Tidal Twister or unwind on the Adventure River, drifting along on a tube, followed by an amazing Wings Of Time show. Later, take the cable car back to Mt.  Faber and get transferred to your hotel for an overnight stay.
